integrity: Closed-form covariance and globally quantified proof, with a supplementary standalone symbolic/numerical checker. Numerical scans are not substituted for proof. Literature comparisons are non-exhaustive; independent publication-priority verification remains open.
scientific_limitations: One known zero-start integrated Brownian process on the unit interval, one co-located value–derivative site, independent Gaussian noises with a freely divisible sum of precisions, and squared-error Bayes estimation; no separate-site, adaptive, correlated-noise or non-Gaussian extensions are claimed. Approximate numerical digits are not certified interval bounds.
title: A sharp precision-budget switch for co-located value–derivative Wiener quadrature
